description: Australian Transport Statistics (2005 and 2006 editions) is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the National Freight Data Hub group and published by BITRE. Members: Australian Transport Statistics 2006; Australian Transport Statistics, June 2005. Example entry: Australian Transport Statistics provides an easy introduction to a diverse range of transport statistics. Topics include employment, GDP, passenger and freight movements, trade, funding, motor vehicles, fatalities and estimated greenhouse gas emissions attributed to the transport industry. Various international comparisons are included and details provided for the road,rail, marine and aviation sectors. Coverage is Australia, 2000 to 2005; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-21. Files and pages listed: PDF (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies and network flow and freight or traffic assignment models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
